name: Cake
summary: Whole round two-layer cake on a stand with frosting drips and berries, for celebrations, bakery and dessert scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the stand rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~480 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = small rock, pop = scale in with overshoot
